findings.evidence: grep `compPosition` finds matches only in HomogeneousSymbol.lean:431-481 and Pullback.lean:437-441; Pullback.lean `compPosition_eq_pullback` is proved by `ext; simp`.
findings.fix: Replace `compPosition` and its lemmas with `pullback` throughout (it has no users outside these two files). Port `compPosition_compPosition` to a `HomogeneousSymbol.pullback_pullback`. Alternatively, define `compPosition` as `pullback g (fun _ ↦ id)` and derive its lemmas instead of proving them separately.
findings.issue: `HomogeneousSymbol.pullback g L` makes `compPosition` its `L = id` case (`compPosition_eq_pullback`). The PR still keeps both, along with a duplicated simp API: `zero_/add_/neg_/sub_/smul_/comp_compPosition` mirror `zero_/add_/neg_/sub_/smul_/comp_pullback`.

findings.evidence: Peetre.lean:182-202 proves the `s ≥ 0` / `s < 0` cases by hand; the new lemma at lines 208-232 repeats the same argument under weaker hypotheses.
findings.fix: Prove `one_add_norm_sq_rpow_le_of_norm_eq_mul` as a corollary: `one_add_norm_sq_rpow_le_of_norm_le_mul hc s h.le (by rw [h]; nlinarith [norm_nonneg y])`. Or drop it and have `one_add_norm_smul_sq_rpow_le` (line 240) call the general lemma directly.
findings.issue: `one_add_norm_sq_rpow_le_of_norm_eq_mul` (hypothesis `‖x‖ = c‖y‖`) is a special case of the new `one_add_norm_sq_rpow_le_of_norm_le_mul`. With `c ≥ 1`, the equality gives both `‖x‖ ≤ c‖y‖` and `‖y‖ ≤ c‖x‖`. The old lemma still has its own case-split rpow proof.

summary: The new pullback operations sit at the natural level, but they leave two strictly weaker special cases with their own duplicated proofs and API: `HomogeneousSymbol.compPosition` (the `L = id` case) and `one_add_norm_sq_rpow_le_of_norm_eq_mul`.
